ssl_security_enabled.description: Whether SSL security is enabled (0 or 1).

ssl_security_dir.description: The directory where SSL security files are stored.

ssl_security_ff_certificate.description: The filename of the Front-End server certificate.

ssl_security_ff_private_key.description: The filename of the Front-End server private key.

ssl_security_ff_ca_certificate.description: The filename of the Front-End CA certificate.

ssl_security_ff_cert_chain_depth.description: The depth of the certificate chain verification.

ssl_security_ff_dh_parameters.description: The filename of the Diffie-Hellman parameters file.

ssl_security_ff_ca_crl_enabled.description: Whether CA CRL checking is enabled (0 or 1).

ssl_security_ff_ca_crl.description: The filename of the CA CRL file.
